Outloud

Live in the room. Shared on screen.

The conversations we have in public. Live formats bring founders, investors and operators into one room to share real stories and work through real questions. Digital content carries those conversations across MENA, in episodes, short reels, VW Notes and the VW Newsletter.

02 · Education · Practical and dynamic

The Venture School

Learn it in practice. Lead it in motion.

Practical, dynamic education for every seat at the table: founders, angels, mentors, intrapreneurs and career professionals. Each topic is taught from every stakeholder's side, through role play, real case studies and guest practitioners, so you leave with frameworks you use the next day. Our flagship program, The Venture Asset Class – Beyond Technicalities, is coming soon.

03 · Services · Fractional leadership & mentorship

BRICKR

We don't consult and leave. We build together.

Two ways to work with us. Fractional leadership puts experienced partners inside your venture or portfolio: in the decisions, in the work, and measured by what it produces, not by hours of advice. Mentorship gives founders and portfolios personal, output-oriented sessions that end in decisions and actions, tracked to completion.

  • Fractional leadership
  • Mentorship for ventures
  • Mentorship for portfolios
  • Venture building and scaling
  • Portfolio infrastructure
  • Innovation hubs

Who it's for

One ecosystem. A place for every stakeholder.

Raising a round, allocating capital, running an accelerator or taking your first step into venture: there is a clear way in for you.

01

Founders and ventures

Bring your hardest question to Open Floor, learn how capital thinks at TVS, and build with a BRICKR partner or mentor beside you.

02

Angel and institutional investors

Sharpen your thesis with TVAC, back portfolio companies with hands-on leadership, and meet founders in the room.

03

Venture studios

Set up the playbooks, people and portfolio infrastructure that turn one venture into many.

04

Corporates

Build a venture arm, train leaders on the venture asset class, and work with the startups shaping your market.

05

Enablers

Hubs, accelerators and incubators: design programs and economics that work, and give cohorts real investment readiness.

06

Experts and mentors

Share what you know on stage and in the classroom, with founders who value practice over theory.

07

Career professionals

Bring your experience into venture as a founder, angel, mentor, operator or enabler. Get the map of the ecosystem and find the role that fits you.

08

Ecosystem newcomers

New to venture? Learn how the ecosystem works and who is in it, hear real stories from every side of the table, and find your place.

💬 How do we get a new idea funded inside a big company?💬 Our story: we pivoted three months before the cash ran out💬 Should I quit my job to build?

Open Floor.

Real stories. Open discussion.

An interactive business session where we share and discuss real venture stories from every side of the table, and the room brings its own experiences and questions. One topic, two hours, hosted by Ahmed Fouad and Karim Hemdan, with expert guests for specific topics.

Who we are

Two ecosystem builders. Built in Cairo, working across MENA.

Combined, we bring 30+ years of experience across different industries, stages and markets, and every space is run hands-on by the two of us.

  • Venture building
  • Venture operations
  • Investment & fund management
  • Consulting
  • Ecosystem building
Co-founder & Managing Partner

Ahmed Fouad

A venture builder and ecosystem enabler with 15 years of cross-functional experience across venture building, investment management, and consulting. With deep experience in the tech ecosystem, building, operating, scaling, and funding ventures across different markets and sectors including e-commerce, health-tech, fintech, F&B, transportation, trading, edtech, and investment.

LinkedIn
Co-founder & Managing Partner

Karim Hemdan

A decade of operating experience across Rocket Internet, Delivery Hero, and Jumia Group in key strategic roles: the companies that defined the first generation of high-growth digital infrastructure in the region. Managing Partner of DINARe Ventures under an Arabian family office, focused on technology ventures in specific MENA markets. Direct fund management experience, with the capital allocator perspective that most platform founders lack entirely.
